mechanics.description: The game world is 800 by 600 pixels with 50-pixel tiles, a player radius of 20, and player speed 3.

Soldiers have radius 12, HP 40, speed 0.8; tanks radius 18, HP 120, speed 0.7; bosses radius 25, HP 360, speed 0.6. The entity types define soldier, tank, and boss enemies and no separate environmental hazard entity type.
Towers have range 150, fire every 1000 milliseconds, and deal damage 10; projectiles have radius 5 and speed 8.

The base starts at HP 100 with radius 40; the tick is 50 milliseconds, spawn rate is 2000 milliseconds, and the active enemy cap is 15. The canonical state has no lives field and instead tracks base HP and maximum base HP (defense-zone health discipline).

Waves 1 through 6 contain respectively 10 soldiers; 8 soldiers and 4 tanks; 10 soldiers, 5 tanks, and 1 boss; 12 soldiers, 8 tanks, and 1 boss; 15 soldiers, 10 tanks, and 2 bosses; and 20 soldiers, 12 tanks, and 3 bosses. Wave-configured spawning emits soldiers before tanks and bosses; without an explicit wave configuration, boss spawning is available from wave 5 below random roll 0.1, tank spawning from wave 2 below random roll 0.3, and soldier is the default. The main tick spawns only until the current wave quota is reached and requires both the spawn interval and the maximum-enemy cap to pass.

tuning_knobs.name: fallback spawn rolls
tuning_knobs.values: boss from wave 5 at roll < 0.1 / tank from wave 2 at roll < 0.3

mechanics.description: The default enemy path is a U-shaped waypoint path from (75,75) through (75,525) and (725,525) to (725,75); the six map configurations provide wave-specific paths, tower slots, and base positions; road tile selection returns EW for horizontal segments, NS for vertical segments, and CORNER with a direction-derived rotation at corners.
Initial state starts in playing status at wave 1 with no enemies, towers, or projectiles, a random sentence, an empty collection, and a randomized 12-by-16 grass map.

Canonical difficulty changes base HP to 150 for easy and 80 for hard while medium retains base HP 100. The reading-advantage logic accepts easy, normal, hard, and extreme difficulties and assigns extreme base HP 50 (host divergence).

tuning_knobs.name: base HP by difficulty
tuning_knobs.values: canonical easy 150 / medium 100 / hard 80; reading-advantage adds extreme 50

mechanics.description: The player movement reducer normalizes diagonal input, scales by delta time, and clamps the player within the world bounds; the canonical game loop clamps frame delta to 50 milliseconds and advances the pure state tick with directional input and vocabulary. The reading-advantage game loop advances with useInterval at GAME_TICK_MS (host divergence).

Enemies move toward their current waypoint and advance the waypoint index when within five pixels of it; circle collision uses the sum of radii and inRange uses squared distance against squared range.

Sentence parsing trims input, splits on whitespace, strips non-alphanumeric edge punctuation, and removes empty words; sentence words spawn as Word records in the middle 50 percent of the board with sentence indices in order; a word collection is valid only when its index equals the number of already collected words and is not already collected; collecting a valid word marks it collected and adds its translation to player inventory; an invalid word sets invalidCollection without marking that word collected, and an invalid collection resets inventory, collected indices, and sentenceCompleted, and respawns the current sentence words.

A tower can be built only when sentenceCompleted is true, the player is within 50 pixels of an empty tower slot, and the slot has no existing tower; building a tower creates an active tower with range 150 and damage 10, clears inventory and sentence progress, and spawns a different next sentence when available. The legacy checkTowerActivation function additionally requires the player to carry the slot targetWord.

tuning_knobs.name: build proximity
tuning_knobs.values: 50 px of an empty tower slot

mechanics.description: Active towers fire only after their cooldown and target the closest enemy within tower range; projectiles move toward their target, apply projectile damage on collision, are removed after a hit or dead target, and dead enemies are filtered out.
Enemies reaching the end of the path are removed and damage the base by 30 for a boss, 15 for a tank, and 10 for a soldier.

The main tick updates time and player movement, collects words, handles resets and tower construction, moves enemies, applies base damage, updates towers and projectiles, scores kills, and marks sentence completion.

Canonical XP uses correct and incorrect collection counts, with bonuses for perfect accuracy, at least half base HP, under 120000 milliseconds, and at least three completed waves, capped at 10. The reading-advantage XP helper returns zero for non-positive score and otherwise returns the score multiplied by 0.01 rounded up (host divergence; also the historical start/end-screens spec XP formula).

tuning_knobs.name: canonical XP bonuses and cap
tuning_knobs.values: perfect accuracy / >= half base HP / under 120000 ms / >= 3 completed waves; cap 10

mechanics.description: Three castles (CastleId union 'left' | 'center' | 'right') each start at MAX_CASTLE_HP = 3; damageCastle reduces the targeted castle HP by 1 clamped to 0 and sets status 'game-over' when all castles reach 0; getCastleRowForHp selects sprite row 0 at full HP, row 1 at HP 2, otherwise row 2; getNearestAliveCastleId returns the closest alive castle by x position and falls back to 'center' when no castle is alive.

spawnMissile picks a random vocabulary item and assigns targetCastleId via getNearestAliveCastleId; enemy motion animates top 30% -> 100% during the 'falling' state with onAnimationComplete invoking onReachBottom(id), and in 'dying' state animates rotate 180 and triggers onDeathComplete; WALK_ANIMATION_CLASS 'enemy-walk' and DEATH_ANIMATION_CLASS 'enemy-die' select CSS animations per missile state.

checkAnswer matches the input by lowercased translation equality against falling missiles; a correct answer increments combo, adds 10 mana, spawns a MagicBolt from a random alive castle, and increments score by 10; a wrong answer plays 'error', shows feedback 'incorrect' for 500 ms, resets combo, and increments totalAttempts.

Each combo milestone of 3 ((combo+1) % 3 === 0) reduces spawnRate by 200 (cap minSpawnRate) and duration by 0.5 s (cap minDuration); SCALING_CONFIG caps the dynamic difficulty with spawnRateAdjustment 200, spawnRateLimit 3000, durationAdjustment 0.5, durationLimit 15.

activateSpecialAbility (Thunder Storm) destroys all falling missiles when mana >= 100, plays 'success', and creates one explosion per falling missile; the Spacebar keyboard event triggers it via a window keydown listener; the HUD displays a 'Ready (Space)' indicator only when mana >= 100 and on sm+ viewports.

A correct answer spawns a MagicBolt from a random alive castle; handleBoltComplete transitions the targeted missile to dying when the bolt reaches the enemy; MagicBolt renders a cyan-400 4x4 px rounded dot with a cyan glow shadow.

The timer counts down from 60 s every 1 s while status is 'playing' and calls endGame() when it hits 0; GAME_CONSTANTS defines timer 60, missileSpawnXRange 25, missileSpawnXOffset 37.5, manaCostSpecial 100; the HUD timer text switches to text-destructive animate-pulse when timeRemaining <= 10.

DIFFICULTY_SETTINGS provides easy/normal/hard/extreme spawnRate and duration pairs; getInitialSettings(diff) returns DIFFICULTY_SETTINGS[diff] or DIFFICULTY_SETTINGS['normal'] for unknown diff values.

A correct orb grants +10 HP (capped), +1 shockwave charge (capped), +10 score and picks a new target; an incorrect orb reshuffles orbs and subtracts 5 score (clamped at 0).
updateZombies spawns one zombie per BASE_SPAWN_RATE_MS*modifiers.spawnRate tick (capped at 50 total) from one of four gates (N/S/W/E off-screen) with damage=10 and scaled speed.

mechanics.description: GAME_WIDTH=800, GAME_HEIGHT=600, PLAYER_RADIUS=20, ZOMBIE_RADIUS=15, ORB_RADIUS=25, INITIAL_HP=100, MAX_SHOCKWAVE_CHARGES=3, INVULNERABILITY_DURATION=500 ms.

DIFFICULTY_MODIFIERS declares speed and spawnRate coefficients per tier; the AG component registers adaptive difficulty params for gameId 'wizard-vs-zombie' with zombieSpeed (min 0.5, max 2.0, default 1.0, step 0.1) and spawnRate (min 0.4, max 1.5, default 1.0, step 0.1).
createWizardZombieState throws 'Vocabulary cannot be empty' if vocabulary.length===0; otherwise it creates a player at world center with hp=100 and spawns four orbs (1 correct, 3 decoys).
advanceWizardZombieTime integrates one frame: normalizes diagonal input, applies speed*dt, clamps to world bounds, then handles shockwave (250 radius, 300 push force).

checkCollisions applies orb collisions: a correct orb grants +10 HP (capped at maxHp), +1 shockwave (capped at maxShockwaveCharges), +10 score and picks a new target; an incorrect orb reshuffles orbs and subtracts 5 score (clamped at 0).
spawnOrbs creates exactly four orbs across the four NW/NE/SW/SE quadrants: one correct orb (isCorrect=true) plus three decoy orbs sampled from vocabulary entries whose term differs from the target.

updateZombies spawns one zombie per BASE_SPAWN_RATE_MS*modifiers.spawnRate tick (capped at 50 total) from one of four gates (N/S/W/E off-screen) with damage=10 and speed = (1.5 + difficultyMultiplier*0.1) * modifiers.speed.
The component loads the four runtime sprite assets (player, zombie, orb, floor) from '/games/vocabulary/wizard-vs-zombie/{player|zombie|orb}_3x3_pose_sheet.png' and 'tile-ruins.png'.
The animation loop advances playerFrame/zombieFrame/orbFrame 0->1->2 every 150 ms while gamePhase === 'playing'.

The game loop runs in requestAnimationFrame with dt clamped at 50 ms, dispatches juice diffing (damage, score, penalty, adaptive response), updates screen-shake/damage-flash/shockwave-ring/floatingTexts, applies the camera transform, and transitions to gamePhase='ended' when nextState.status === 'gameover'.
The HUD overlay renders HP, shockwave charges (max 3, ⚡ glyph), score, and the 'Find: <targetWord>' prompt.

The Konva Stage renders the floor via Rect fillPatternRepeat='repeat', the player KonvaImage (64x64, offset 32), the shockwaveFX Rect when active, zombies (48x48, offset 24), and orbs with a KonvaImage + Text translation label.
The FX layer renders a red damage-flash overlay when damageFlash > 0 (opacity = damageFlash, z-40); floating texts are projected into screen space using dimensions/camera and fade out by life.

wizardZombieIndicators computes off-screen orb indicators: for each orb outside the viewport AABB, a marker is placed at the viewport edge intersected by the orb direction (margin=40); the AG component imports calculateIndicators and uses it to render off-screen orbs.
The advantage-games page submit payload sends score=results.xp, correctAnswers, totalAttempts, accuracy*100, difficulty to the completion API.
The advantage-games page fetches vocabulary from /api/v1/games/wizard-vs-zombie/vocabulary and falls back to a fixed 5-word Spanish set on empty/error response.

control_surfaces.description: The virtual controls block renders a circular CAST button (touchTarget-scaled) and a VirtualDPad (scale(touchTarget/128)) in the bottom-right (WVZ-MECH-013); the CAST action drives the shockwave (250 radius, 300 push force, WVZ-MECH-004).

The advantage-games host renders the shared GameStartScreen inside the gamePhase === 'start' branch (WVZ-COMP-004); the selected difficulty is stored in the selectedDifficulty useState with initial value 'medium' (WVZ-STT-002).

The reading-advantage bespoke StartScreen (WVZ-COMP-003) fetches rankings from /api/v1/games/wizard-vs-zombie/ranking?difficulty=<tier> when the rankings tab is active (WVZ-MECH-021) and renders the zombie pose sheet as a CSS-frame sprite animation in the briefing tab (WVZ-MECH-022).
The RA gameover overlay renders PlayAgain + Exit-to-Menu buttons inside AnimatePresence (WVZ-MECH-024).

The answer input model is physical contact with quadrant-spawned orbs: one correct orb plus three decoys (WVZ-MECH-007); checkCollisions resolves correct vs incorrect contact (WVZ-MECH-005). No typed-answer claim exists in the ledger for this game.

learning_goals.description: Vocabulary term-to-translation recognition under pursuit pressure: the catalog card description reads 'Survive the horde by collecting vocabulary orbs.' (WVZ-ID-003); spawnOrbs places one correct orb and three decoys sampled from vocabulary entries whose term differs from the target (WVZ-MECH-007); the HUD renders the 'Find: <targetWord>' prompt (WVZ-MECH-012) and orbs carry a Text translation label (WVZ-MECH-014).

terminal_result_mechanic.description: The logic status union is 'playing' | 'gameover' (WVZ-STT-003); the rAF loop transitions gamePhase to 'ended' when nextState.status === 'gameover' (WVZ-MECH-011). The ended branch renders the shared GameEndScreen with status='defeat' and gameId='wizard-vs-zombie' (AG, WVZ-COMP-005) or the RA gameover overlay with score/accuracy/XP-gained tiles plus PlayAgain and Exit-to-Menu buttons (WVZ-MECH-024). The AG page submit payload sends score=results.xp, correctAnswers, totalAttempts, accuracy*100, difficulty to the completion API (WVZ-MECH-017) via the factory route (WVZ-ROUTE-003) or the RA controller-backed route (WVZ-ROUTE-005).
terminal_result_mechanic.vocabulary_scoring_association: Terminal scoring derives from orb-based vocabulary recognition: correct orb contact grants +10 score (WVZ-MECH-005) against the current target word (WVZ-MECH-007, WVZ-MECH-012); correctAnswers and totalAttempts are submitted with the completion payload (WVZ-MECH-017).
